page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r7a.32xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 128 dedicated physical cores on an x86_64 architecture, utilizing AMD EPYC 7T83 processors running at a base frequency of 2.55 GHz. The instance is configured with 1024.0 GB of system memory, providing a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core.

This instance does not include any local NVMe or SSD storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met through attached network block storage. It delivers a baseline network bandwidth of 32 Gbps. The CPU allocation is fully dedicated with a 1.0 thread-per-core configuration, ensuring predictable performance without resource sharing or hyperthreading overhead.

Given the high memory density and dedicated CPU allocation, the ecs.r7a.32xlarge offers qualitative resource efficiency for memory-intensive workloads that require substantial RAM without the need for local storage or GPU acceleration. It is designed for large-scale databases, in-memory caching systems, enterprise applications, and memory-heavy data processing pipelines.
